name: search_pmc
description: Search PubMed Central (PMC) for scientific articles with optional citation-based reranking. Supports standard PMC search syntax including field tags ([Title], [Author], [Journal]), boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), quoted phrases, and relative date filters such as 'last 2 years[dp]'. Structured results are returned in structuredContent.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for a PMC search.

query.description: PMC search query. Use PMC syntax, e.g. 'CRISPR gene editing' or 'mRNA vaccine COVID-19 AND last 2 years[dp]'.

rerank_by.description: Set to 'references' to rank results by citation count within the result set. Omit to return results in PMC relevance order.

status.description: 'success' for a successful search, 'error' when the search failed.

query.description: The original query string submitted to the tool.

total_found.description: Total number of articles returned from PMC before the returned-count limit was applied.

returned.description: Number of articles included in the articles array.

ranked_by.description: 'references' when results are reranked by citation count, otherwise omitted or null.

articles.description: Matching articles, ordered by PMC relevance or citation count depending on ranked_by.

url.description: Canonical URL derived from the DOI.

reference_count.description: Number of references cited by this article.

referenced_by_count.description: Number of articles in this result set that cite this article.

message.description: Error description. Only present when status is 'error'.
